pull_requests.title: DCEL Block and Face Morphology Measurement
pull_requests.goal: Add generator-independent block/face measurements that distinguish networks with similar street scalar metrics but different spatial organization.
scope: Measure exact face area, perimeter, compactness, aspect ratio, block density, service gap, internal motorized-edge density, and perimeter road-class composition.
Use explicit SI units and exact area where available.
Record distributions and quantiles; do not introduce empirical pass thresholds in this PR.
Support synthetic and OSM topologies when a valid planar surface embedding exists.
out_of_scope: Creating acceptance bounds before observing development and fresh evaluation data.
red: Create exact square, rectangle, elongated strip, L-shape, and disconnected fixtures.
Test rejection of invalid/nonplanar surface input.
green: Implement measurement directly on DCEL faces.
Add canonical serialization and a versioned measurement spec.
steps: Define compactness as 4*pi*A/P^2 and state dimensionless range.
Define aspect ratio through a deterministic oriented bounding box or an explicitly simpler proxy.
Avoid using the legacy seven-metric envelope as a block gate.
acceptance: Fixture values match analytic results within declared tolerances.
Measurement is invariant to face ordering and edge orientation.
Every result records units and measurement-spec version.
No empirical pass/fail threshold is introduced.
Current style/development seeds produce a diagnostic artifact for later preregistration.

claim.allowed: MetroFlow can measure block/face morphology reproducibly

stop: The PR begins tuning generator parameters or acceptance bounds.
pull_requests.codex_prompt:
Implement MAP-PR-006 as a measurement-only PR. Build exact mathematical
fixtures first, then derive block/face metrics from existing DCEL authority.
Record full distributions and explicit units. Do not tune the generator and
do not invent pass thresholds. This PR creates the instrument required for
later preregistered external validation.

pull_requests.title: Fresh OSM Evaluation Corpus and Sampling Policy
pull_requests.goal: Create a development/evaluation split with explicit spatial sampling boundaries and importer semantics for external morphology comparison.
scope: Freeze existing extracts as development/reference fixtures only.
Add new offline OSM evaluation fixtures not used in prior tuning.
Declare sampling stratum for each fixture: fixed-area core, density-matched crop, or administrative polygon.
Record source date, polygon/bounds, area, importer policy, and source SHA.
Choose one importer policy for evaluation and report failures as data, not silently switch policy.
out_of_scope: Learning generator parameters from the new evaluation corpus.
Changing morphology thresholds after seeing evaluation results.
red: Add manifest completeness and duplicate-city/bounds tests.
Add tests forbidding overlap with the development fixture SHA set.
green: Add the minimum viable fresh corpus and structured manifest.
Run both strict and selected evaluation policy as diagnostics, while designating one authoritative policy.
steps: Select corpus before generator tuning under MAP-PR-008.
Keep city names as provenance, not targets to imitate.
Use diverse morphology and at least two sampling strata if feasible.
Document copyright/licensing and source retrieval metadata only as needed for lawful research reuse; do not add security machinery.
acceptance: No evaluation fixture SHA appears in the development fixture set.
Every fixture has explicit spatial boundary and area.
Every fixture imports or fails with a typed reason under the authoritative policy.
CI uses committed local bytes only.
No generator source or parameter is changed in this PR.

claim.allowed: a fresh, offline, explicitly sampled evaluation corpus exists
claim.not_allowed: generator quality is established before MAP-PR-008

stop: Proposed fixtures have already influenced generator tuning.
Sampling boundaries cannot be documented reproducibly.
pull_requests.codex_prompt:
Implement MAP-PR-007 as a data/evidence PR only. Freeze all existing OSM
extracts as development/reference data. Add a fresh offline evaluation corpus
with explicit sample boundaries, area, source hash, source date, and one
authoritative importer policy. Tests must prove no fixture hash overlaps the
development set and CI performs no network access. Do not change generator
code or thresholds after seeing the data.

pull_requests.title: Scalable Synthetic V2 Empirical Morphology Benchmark
pull_requests.goal: Evaluate scalable_synthetic_v2 on preregistered street and block morphology measures using fresh seeds and the fresh OSM corpus.
scope: Create a new benchmark/schema rather than reinterpret v4.
Select fresh generator seeds that have not appeared in development or prior audits.
Preregister metric definitions and comparisons before running the evaluation.
Report per-style distributions, topology invariants, block metrics, and OSM strata without tuning.
Use structured attempts/skips and exact artifact reproduction.
out_of_scope: Modifying generator code or thresholds in response to benchmark results.
red: Add schema, duplicate-key, exact-attempt-partition, and artifact-reproduction tests.
Add test forbidding previously consumed seed values.
Add test forbidding development OSM fixture hashes.
green: Implement generator and OSM evaluation arms.
Run the frozen matrix once and commit all outcomes, including negative ones.
steps: Write preregistration metadata before executing the matrix.
Include G0 topology results, G1 structural style results, legacy street metrics, and G2 block metrics.
Stratify OSM results by sampling policy.
Use distances/distributions with uncertainty rather than a single pass count where possible.
Do not promote runtime behavior in this PR.
acceptance: Every generated and OSM attempt is uniquely represented as score or typed skip.
No fresh seed or evaluation fixture was used in generator development.
Artifacts reproduce on the pinned research environment.
Negative results remain committed without post-hoc threshold changes.
Claim boundary explicitly denies traffic/default promotion.

claim.allowed: specific preregistered morphology results on a fresh evaluation matrix
claim.not_allowed: global urban realism or traffic validity

stop: A desired threshold is selected after viewing evaluation results.
Generator source changes are proposed in the same PR.
pull_requests.codex_prompt:
Implement MAP-PR-008 as a frozen evaluation PR. Before running anything,
write the preregistration metadata: fresh seeds, fresh OSM fixture hashes,
measures, strata, and comparison rules. Then implement and run a new
scalable_synthetic_v2 benchmark. Include every negative result. Do not alter
generator code, thresholds, or historical v4 artifacts. This PR measures;
it does not repair.
